scripts.build: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'go build -o /app/tmp/tareas ./cmd/tareas'
scripts.lint: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'go vet ./...'
scripts.check-types: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c 'go build ./...'
scripts.test: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock backend sh -c 'go test ./...'
scripts.migrations:new: sh -c 'if [ -z "${NAME}" ]; then echo "Usage: NAME=migration_name bun run migrations:new"; exit 1; fi; docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/internal/database/migrations:/migrations" migrate/migrate create -ext sql -dir /migrations -seq ${NAME}'
